name: W London-Leicester Square
insider_take: This sleek W hotel puts you at the beating heart of London's entertainment district, where West End magic meets contemporary luxury in one of the world's most famous squares.
whats_special: Located directly on Leicester Square, you're literally steps from world-class theaters, iconic red phone boxes, and the bustling energy of London's entertainment hub. The hotel's signature W style brings bold design and vibrant nightlife to this historic location, while the square itself hosts major film premieres and street performances year-round.
pro_tip: Book theater tickets through the hotel concierge - they often have access to last-minute premium seats, and you can walk to most West End shows in under 5 minutes.
dont_miss: The rooftop views overlooking Leicester Square and beyond, plus easy access to Chinatown (2-minute walk), Covent Garden (5 minutes), and Piccadilly Circus (3 minutes). The square's central location makes it perfect for exploring London's most famous attractions on foot.
pros: Prime Leicester Square location in heart of West End theater district
Contemporary design with signature W Hotels modern aesthetic and vibrant atmosphere
Excellent proximity to major attractions, shopping, and entertainment venues
High-quality amenities and sophisticated urban hotel experience
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Leicester Square properties
Busy central location may be noisy for light sleepers
